request.prompt_en: A vertical photograph of an adult woman in her late twenties making a playful seductive bid for the viewer's attention at the velvet-curtained balcony entrance of a late-night Art Deco jazz salon. Her visible face and dark bob with wispy bangs follow the supplied portrait. Her gaze and gesture combine into a deliberately flirtatious invitation addressed to the viewer. She closes her right eye in a deliberate wink; her open left eye meets the camera. A knowing smile lifts one corner of her lips. Her left hand reaches forward at chest height, palm up, with the index finger curling toward herself in a clear come-closer gesture. Her right hand gathers the plum velvet curtain at shoulder height, keeping the opening clear beside her. Her weight rests on the leg nearest the salon, with her shoulders half-turned into the doorway and her face returned to the viewer. Her neck joins the returning head smoothly to the inward-turned shoulders, while the open left iris remains aimed at the viewer. She wears a deep-red silk halter mini dress, its softly draped neckline and bare shoulders catching a warm edge of light. Amber salon light brushes her cheek and the curtain folds; cool blue balcony light defines the opposite edge. The room behind her resolves into an amber pool of light and a few blurred brass architectural lines. Frame her from above the knees to just above her head, with both hands fully visible. A natural eye-level 50 mm perspective keeps her face, inviting hand and interrupted turn equally legible, with tangible silk, velvet and natural skin texture.
